identity.name: DHFR replica ensembles on one GPU: sequential versus concurrent MPS
identity.fixed_work_variant: Driver dhfr_ensemble.py embedded in brief; not independently published or CUDA-validated.

outcome_definition.primary: Total wall time to finish 8 independent replicas of 25000 steps on one GPU.
outcome_definition.scientific_outputs: Per-replica final and mean potential energy in kJ/mol, sampled every 250 steps.

citations.title: Hsu, Clark and Paulsen (2025-06-04), Maximizing OpenMM Molecular Dynamics Throughput with NVIDIA Multi-Process Service

source_licences_and_intended_use_permiss.component: OpenMM API, Reference and CPU platforms

source_licences_and_intended_use_permiss.reason: No separate per-file licence verified; distributed with OpenMM. Brief explicitly states local running and modification permitted.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock image manifest, GPU, driver, Python ABI, MPS executable and service permissions not supplied or inspected; no reproduction run.
stock_cuda_image.requirements: Linux x86_64 glibc >=2.27; Python 3.10-3.13 wheels available; CUDA-12-capable NVIDIA driver and one supported GPU. MPS required for proposed concurrent method.
stock_cuda_image.dependency_pins_reason: Transitive versions not fixed by brief.

size.reason: Peak host/device memory for sequential or eight concurrent contexts not published or measured. Input byte total excludes environment installation.

scoring.performance: Lower ensemble wall time; report aggregate ns/day and speedup on same single GPU.
scoring.reason: Published throughput observation is a reference for a different timing protocol, not an acceptance test for fixed-work variant. Brief speedup ranges are predictions.
scoring.scientific_correctness: Brief predicts identical per-seed energy series; fallback compares mean-energy difference against same-seed sequential run-to-run variation. Neither numerical fallback threshold nor repeat count specified.
scoring.energy_series_reason: Embedded driver retains samples internally and writes only final and mean values.

repeatability.random_streams: Same replica seed assigned to integrator and initial velocities.
repeatability.limitation: Documented deterministic CUDA forces do not constitute verification of identical stochastic trajectories across concurrent scheduling. Brief CUDA driver untested.

search.reason: Verified brief-linked primary sources directly; no alternative benchmark search.
